Subject: AlloHealth kickoff — confirm sprint‑zero meeting and attendee roles

Hi Tim / Sara —

Thanks again for selecting Redwood for the pilot. We'd like to lock in a 90‑minute Sprint‑Zero kickoff to align scope, review access, and confirm success criteria. Proposed windows (all ET):

- Thu May 23 — 2:00–3:30 PM
- Fri May 24 — 11:00–12:30 PM
- Mon May 27 — 10:00–11:30 AM

Draft agenda (attached):
1) Introductions & roles (10m)
2) Goals & success criteria for Sprint 0 (15m)
3) Scope walk-through: data/SSO/access & non-production environment (25m)
4) Implementation plan & timeline (20m)
5) Risks/blocks, next steps, immediate prework (20m)

Attendee ask: please confirm which of these internal stakeholders will join from your side and who will be the technical owner for SSO/access:
- Customer PM (product)
- Engineering lead (API/infra)
- Security/compliance contact (if applicable)

On our side: Neha (CS lead), Marissa (Implementation lead), Ben (Solutions Engineer), Monica (Technical PM).

Attachments: kickoff-agenda-allohealth-v1.pdf, sprint0-scope-allohealth.xlsx (I included a short prework checklist in the agenda). If you can confirm preferred window by EOD tomorrow we'll send a calendar invite and a Zoom bridge.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Neha — thanks for the clear options. Thu May 23 2:00–3:30 PM ET works best for our team. I'll be on the call, and I'll bring Priya Nair (implementation lead) and Sara Allo (product).

Attendee list from AlloHealth:
- Timothy James, Director of Product (tim.james@allohealth.com)
- Priya Nair, Implementation Lead (priya.nair@allohealth.com)
- Sara Allo, Product Owner (sara.allo@allohealth.com)
- Optional: Mike Chen, Security (if we need to cover data handling) — we'll confirm tomorrow.

We have a couple of prework items — I'll share access to our staging S3 bucket and the internal PAM contact (if needed) before the call.

Thanks — see you Thursday.
Tim
